name: lipi-expense-tracker
description: Lipi's MCP server for your money books (spending, budgets, accounts, loans and EMIs, across currencies): sign in to Lipi, Read only or Full access. Plus optional skills that build on it: cash flow forecast, spending and net worth explainers, subscription audit, budget builder, savings plans, loan prepayment what-ifs, books cleanup, settle-up, invoice follow-up and a year-end pack.
